description: Conversion of the garage into a habitable room and associated external work including the replacement of the garage door with a window.
decision_conditions: A1(a) permission to use the dwellinghouse as a dwellinghouse has not been granted only by virtue of Class M, N, P, PA or Q of Part 3 of this Schedule (changes of use);

A1(b) as a result of the work the total area of ground covered by buildings within the curtilage of the dwellinghouse (other than the original dwellinghouse) would not exceed 50% of the total area of the curtilage

A1(e) the enlarged part of the dwellinghouse would not extend beyond a wall which  -(i) forms the principal elevation of the original dwellinghouse; or(ii) fronts a highway and forms a side elevation of the original dwellinghouse

A3(a) the materials used in any exterior work (other than materials used in the construction of a conservatory) shall be of a similar appearance to those used in the construction of the exterior of the existing dwellinghouse
A1(l) the dwellinghouse has not been built under Part 20 of this Schedule (construction of new dwellinghouses).

Planning permission is not required by virtue of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 Schedule 2 Part 1 Class A as the proposed garage conversion does not exceed the dimensions or infringe any of the other criteria set out in Class A.
